description.zh:
网站业务的域名。
> 域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用[DescribeDomains](~~91724~~)查询所有域名。
description.en:
The domain name of the website.

> A forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. You can call the [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) operation to query all domain names.

description.zh:
要查询的请求数据的结束时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：秒。

> 必须为整点分钟。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

> This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute.

description.zh: 查询数据的时间粒度，支持300、 3600和86400秒。3天以内（不包含3天整）支持300、 3600、 86400。3-31天（不包含31天整）支持3600和86400。31天以上支持86400。不传和传的值不支持时，使用默认值。
description.en: The interval for returning data. Unit: seconds. Valid values are 300, 3600, and 86400. If the time span between StartTime and EndTime is less than 3 days, valid values are 300, 3600, and 86400. If the time span between StartTime and EndTime is from 3 to 30 days, valid values are 3600 and 86400. If the time span between StartTime and EndTime is 31 days or longer, the valid value is 86400. If you leave this parameter empty or specify an invalid value, the default value is used.

description.zh:
服务地域。取值：
- **cn**：中国内地。
- **cn-hongkong**：非中国内地。
description.en:
The region in which your service is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn**: a region in the Chinese mainland.

- **cn-hongkong**: a region outside the Chinese mainland.

description.zh:
要查询的请求数据的开始时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：秒。

> 必须为整点分钟。
description.en:
The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

> This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo describe-domain-bps --biz-region cn --domain www.example.com --start-time 1719211800 --end-time 1722339300 --interval 600 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
